title: Leome and Partners word reveal
description: Inline text whose words rise out of clipping masks: once on page load with a staggered expo ease, or scrubbed as each word scrolls into view, so whole lines rise together and the next line follows. Pure CSS, no text splitting by JavaScript.
notes: takes font, size and colour from its parent; put it inside the heading or paragraph
view mode uses CSS scroll-driven animations; without support the text stands still
name: leome-and-partners-word-reveal

props.name: text
props.description: the text; it is split on spaces and every word rises out of its own mask

props.name: trigger
props.description:
"load": the words rise once as the page loads (use it in the first screen).
"view": the words rise as they scroll into view; words on one line move together and
the next line follows, which reads as the original's line-by-line reveal.

props.name: delay
props.description: load only: seconds before the first word starts

props.name: stagger
props.description: load only: seconds between one word and the next
